title: Words of comfort, actions of certainty

words.sense: tell someone confidently to remove doubt
misconceptions: a reassuring promise itself guarantees the result
making a promise and securing an outcome are the same action

semantic_axes.description: a person’s doubt versus the certainty of an outcome

edges.boundary_rule: Assure addresses a person’s doubt; ensure makes an outcome happen.
clues_b: takes steps that secure the result

beats.text: A traveller worries about missing a bus. Nabil tells her, “You have plenty of time,” hoping to calm her.
beats.decisive_clue: tells her, “You have plenty of time,”
beats.reason: His action is giving a worried person confidence.

hints.attention: Is this action addressing worry or making an outcome happen?
hints.contrast: Words can give a person confidence; checks and safeguards can make an outcome certain.

beats.text: Nabil now sets two alarms and books a car early enough to get her to the stop before departure.
beats.decisive_clue: sets two alarms and books a car early enough
beats.reason: This new action is a practical safeguard for reaching the stop on time.

hints.attention: Is this action addressing worry or making an outcome happen?
hints.contrast: Words can give a person confidence; checks and safeguards can make an outcome certain.

beats.text: When she asks whether the plan is reliable, Nabil looks at her and says, “I have checked it; you can count on it.”
beats.reason: The current action is speaking to remove her doubt about the plan.

hints.attention: Is this action addressing worry or making an outcome happen?
hints.contrast: Words can give a person confidence; checks and safeguards can make an outcome certain.

chains.feedback_short: Speaking to a worried person and securing a result are different actions.
chains.feedback_deep: Judge the action described in each new beat. Nabil first gives reassurance, then removes the practical risk, then returns to reassuring the traveller.
chains.contrast_rule: Assure addresses a person’s doubt; ensure makes an outcome happen.
